notes.title: Adjustable UI and much more
notes.content:
An update was just set live containing a bevy of changes.

First and foremost, I've added adjustable UI.
A better first-time user experience awaits.  No longer will you be dropped in an oversize recliner in the middle of a strange art deco world and left to your own devices.  No!

The default menu is now the browser, so you can jump right into viewing the latest shared tunescapes.  And after viewing a tunescape, the menu will once again revert to the browser for selection of another to view.

In less technical terms, it's easier to use & understand now.

notes.title: Startup changes
notes.content: The latest build (0.1.1) starts you off at the help introduction screen if no immediate move is made to open or cycle the menu.  The default menu has also been set to the browser now, so you can quickly jump right into finding new tunescapes to explore!

notes.title: The Sharing Update soft launch -- It's Live NOW
notes.content:
[b]The Sharing Update[/b] has been made available ahead of schedule for sharp-eyed bargain hunters.  Pick it up now while it's still cheap, because the price is going UP!  

[url=http://tunescapevr.com/release-notes/]Release Notes[/url]
This is a MAJOR update adding all kinds of functionality and warmth to Tunescape.  Share your creations, as well as download and view those created by others with the new browser menu.  

If you need help getting started, here's a 7-part tutorial series I put together to help answer questions you may have:
[url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ATiTbpkjaMU&list=PLZPDl2i4zxINU17M9ILGiLsppCij5jpKx[/url]

notes.title: Progress Report -- Big update coming soon!
notes.content:
The Sharing Update isn't far off!  I've put together a progress report over on the website, detailing everything that's being upgraded and added.  Obviously, the biggest addition will be the ability to share your Tunescapes and download others' creations to view (finally)!

[b][url=http://tunescapevr.com/2018/04/16/sharingupdate/]Progress Report: The Sharing Update[/url][/b]

Huge thanks to the early supporters of Tunescape, btw.  If you haven't picked up a copy yet, do it soon, because the [b]price will be going up with the release of The Sharing Update[/b]!

notes.title: Update 0.0.851 Live
notes.content:
The latest update brings another round of bug fixes and minor cosmetic adjustments, as well as Oculus Dash support.  But the bulk of the new content here is in the form of a demo Tunescape, which can be accessed from the Settings screen.  It should help give you a few ideas about where you can start on your own creations.

Full release notes, as always, can be found at [url]http://tunescapevr.com/release-notes/[/url]

notes.title: Demo Tunescape coming soon
notes.content:
It's come to my attention that it's not immediately clear what it is you DO in Tunescape.  Along with posting a [url=http://tunescapevr.com/2018/01/23/what-is-tunescape/]page on the website[/url], I've been putting together a demo Tunescape to go out with the first update.  

A big part of the enjoyment of Tunescape is kicking back and just enjoying the experience.  There's not much to see yet, since nobody's had a chance to create!  As more Tunescapes are made available to download from users who wish to share, viewing will become a much larger part of the application.

notes.title: BUY button unavailable
notes.content: Although the release state of Tunescape has been changed to 'Released', the option to buy is not showing up on the store page.  This has been relayed to Steam support, and we're eagerly awaiting a response in order to fix the issue.  Apologies for the delay, we'll have it available just as soon as is possible.
